## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      18 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Oct 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _emilie_hys_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "It worked really well but now the whole app is buggy, I could easily change the writing colors by tapping on the dots at the edge of the line/paragraph but it doesn't work anymore. moreover, as soon as I try to write a letter it rewinds my text which means that I cannot see what I am writing..; It's a shame it was great before that"
            2. _K.loves20_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "So far Notion has been great, my number 1 go to for note taking among other things. But now the app has been more of nuisance than anything because it has several glitches now. For one, whenever I highlight a paragraph and try applying italic, or bold to it, it only applies to the first word and only allows me to edit that first word. Another recent development being that whenever I try highlighting a text to put it in a different color, by the time I go to the color menu the entire thing becomes deselected and uncolorable. Please fix this."
            3. _BlA387532_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
